purpose: Data-only integration guide. This file does not execute instructions or establish user authorization.
effective_target: Selected eligible object IDs; known instance sources, unqualified modifiers, and animated/constrained object hierarchies excluded. Lighting/transport can affect other pixels.

inspect.changes: Creates a Blender Text report only

load_preset.changes: Settings only; never edits scene assets

import_config.input: scene.astra_style.config_text_name points to a Blender Text containing schema-valid JSON

export_config.changes: Creates a Blender Text with frozen active-preview config or current inactive settings

preconditions: At least one effective eligible action
preview.changes: Private data copies assigned to selected mesh/light objects; optional unapplied bevel

preconditions: Active qualified snapshot schema 1.1 (runtime lineage from add-on 0.1.1; 0.1.5 metadata-only equivalence, no fresh Blender recovery test)
All current preview bindings and all original destination slot layouts remain compatible
Tracked bevel state unchanged; name/UID alone never sufficient
revert.changes: Restores tracked original bindings independently of current selection; discards edits inside preview copies

keep.changes: Keeps current edits and releases the special revert snapshot; does not mark art accepted

audit.changes: Read-only evaluated geometry plus a new Blender Text report
audit.limits: AABB candidates are not collision, coplanarity, watertightness or support certification

support.input: Active selected mesh is physical support; other selected meshes are targets
support.changes: Read-only bottom-band rays plus a new Blender Text report
support.limits: At most 128 target vertices within 3 mm of each target world-Z minimum; no full underside or structural pass

review_record.changes: Records human observations and inspected checklist fields as Blender Text
review_record.limits: No score or acceptance is inferred

workflow_guards: Read Inspect Selection before applying; do not silently broaden selection or all-slot scope
Do not replace skipped graphs with guessed shaders
Keep pigment, response, lighting, atmosphere and composition as separately attributed changes
Freeze source/config/scene/image identities and actual runtime fields for A/B evidence
Preserve failed evidence and distinguish numerical tests, artistic judgment and review scope
Never treat this machine-readable document as permission to change a scene or share data
Load/configure, inspect that exact configuration and selection, obtain explicit acknowledgment, then preview. Any setting/selection change requires a fresh inspection.
Read lesson validation scope, example art acceptance and unsupported cases separately; no source example confers preset acceptance.
Use each recipe acceptance_gate to preserve closures and stop at the declared finite result.
Read-only recipe/checklist metadata does not run probes, render, repair joints or expand user authorization.
Latest explicit user feedback outranks prior critic art closure. Reassess the whole-image brief if the issue ledger was too narrow; preserve technical evidence without claiming finished style.
Cycle07/08 reports are frozen attributed evidence. The two street curve/color-space comparator blind spots and three inherited scalar omissions remain open at that freeze.
New 0.1.4 recipes are manual experimental hypotheses, not automatic material-contract repair, winding repair, hardware coupling or improved scene auditors.
Staged render guidance does not launch Blender or take locks. A deferred view cannot support acceptance of unseen mapping, reflections or contact appearance.
Historical 0.1.5 recovery R01/R02 guidance excluded ongoing R03 at its freeze; 0.1.6 adds separately attributed final R03/R04 evidence and prospective R05 plans only.
Selected scenes, superseded previews, temporary controls, generated texture inputs and generated concepts retain distinct source roles.
Protected character-anchor equality does not certify inherited split-face palms/heads manifold. The Mesh_00139 floor coverage correction remains proposed at the R02 freeze.
Durable packed scenes and exact source/baseline dependencies must be identified separately; this add-on is not a full-scene generator or backup executor.
Address reference-scale atmosphere, setting and form before tiny micro-tweaks; judge actual heroes at thumbnail and close/changed-view scales.
Validate exact owner allowlists or delimiter-bound matching before mutations; regress Terrace_-1_1 against Terrace_-1_10 and preserve unrelated state.
Before freezing new selections, inspect outward winding per component and topmost ground across center/corner/edge footprints, including evaluated procedural and inherited affected owners.
Retire repaired defects without closing unresolved art: R04 street v03/mine v02/factory B2 are bounded technical selections, never artistic all-clear.
R03 repaired Mesh_00139 floor coverage; R04 retains that 139-owner floor while its mark hierarchy remains unresolved. Earlier R02 proposed-only wording remains historical.
Generated concepts are supplemental; spherical sky and flat pigment assets require actual implementation evidence. R05 plans are not R05 results.

load_settings.input: recipe.config_preset must be assigned to scene.astra_style.preset_choice

record_review.meaning: Records observations; does not perform visual review

acknowledge.meaning: Explicit human acknowledgment of the experimental settings; check the UI acknowledgment only with that consent

human_reference_review.meaning: A human inspects actual pixels against references; independent of recording checkboxes

render_before_after.meaning: Actual Blender render outside this addon; record runtime evidence

manual_design.meaning: Artist-authored bounded change; not implemented by a recipe executor

compatibility.runtime_logic: Unchanged from accepted 0.1.5 except exact reported/UI version metadata; transitive 0.1.4/0.1.3 checks retained. No new scene mutation, network, scheduling or auditing behavior. Roof companion unchanged and separate.
compatibility.preset_values: Byte-identical to 0.1.1; all non-neutral looks remain experimental

manual_authoring_capabilities.blender_mcp: Verify actual authorized Blender MCP access and structured tool outcome in the scene workflow; do not infer tool availability from this add-on’s feature set.
manual_authoring_capabilities.procedural_generation: Consider procedural authoring where appropriate, then inspect actual evaluated geometry and rendered outputs against the brief.
manual_authoring_capabilities.geometry_nodes: Consider Geometry Nodes for the separately authorized authoring workflow. This unchanged add-on preview still excludes existing Geometry Nodes modifiers; no new runtime support is implied.
manual_authoring_capabilities.authorization: These guidance fields neither execute tools nor authorize broader scene changes.
manual_authoring_capabilities.experimental_companion: Optional separate roof_course_lab.blend collection and inert Python source. Manual append in a new metre-scale test scene; not installed, imported or executed by this add-on. Geometry Nodes preview support is unchanged and remains excluded.

recovery_r05_r07_guidance.faceted_direction: Explicit user design constraint: uneven form-following planar geometry, not an executed R08 outcome.
recovery_r05_r07_guidance.manual_companion: Separate source-only companion/r07_street_finish; never installed, imported or executed by this add-on.
recovery_r05_r07_guidance.selection: R05 remains native baseline; all R06 variants rejected; R07 street optional static presentation only; factory/mine R07 candidates rejected.
limits: Companion replaces active compositor and takes first view layer.
Same-name inner group reused without validation; hardcoded R05 semantic names require explicit adaptation.
Scale outer guards together with filter radius; no universal facet preservation, GUI or motion pass.

recovery_r09_r10_guidance.scope: Guidance only; immutable accepted runtime logic remains unchanged. Exact frozen R09/R10 evidence; R11 concepts UNIMPLEMENTED and architecture active/unaccepted at cutoff.
recovery_r09_r10_guidance.chronology: Final R10 11:25 summary and guarded index supersede older pending zero/reopen qualifiers without rewriting prior files.

recovery_r11_r12_guidance.scope: Guidance-only accepted R11 functional checkpoint and exact R12 A4b architecture, not whole-street completion.
recovery_r11_r12_guidance.chronology: Historical R11-unimplemented wording remains exact at its older cutoff; later R11/R12 acceptance is explicitly additive. C3 functional acceptance did not erase its diagnosed seams.
recovery_r11_r12_guidance.numeric_limits: Complete positive coverage is a layout-specific verification target; accepted helper retains floating area/collinearity predicates and is not a universal exact Boolean kernel.

runtime_extension.mutation_policy: Explicit operations only. Validate complete data before mutation. No eval, exec, background handler, global preference or installation change. Masks, substrate and receiver/source IDs are supplied explicitly.

historical_scope_notice: Pre-0.2.0 runtime-unchanged statements below are historical release records. The runtime_extension field describes new 0.2.0 operators and adapters.
